Ruling

No change NO_ACTION

No money moves. The charge stands.

The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties. This dispute turns on a single numeric gate, and it decides the case. The platform's booked optimal route for this trip is 12.0 km (trip_record EV-TRIP-02841). POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace the governing distance and expressly bars the trip_record's rounded copy from the threshold test, so the measure is the trace figure of 14.39 km (EV-GPS-02841). Excess = 14.39 - 12.0 = 2.39 km. That clears the absolute limb (greater than 0.8 km) but POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass: the excess must also be greater than 20% of optimal, and 2.39 / 12.0 = 19.92%, which is not greater than 20%. Reading the trip_record's convenience copy of 14.4 km would give exactly 20.0%, still not greater than 20%, and POL-RD-01 forbids citing it in any event. The establishment test therefore fails and no deviation exists, 'however the rider characterises the trip'. The outcome is NO_ACTION: the fare stands as charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The rider's own advocate reached the same conclusion, and the driver's advocate's threshold argument is accepted on the trace figure. On the driver's explanation: his counterparty statement says only 'a minor detour because of a road works sign' and cites no advisory. The only traffic_advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02841-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and no advisory covers this corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 an uncited traffic excuse carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-03 is unavailable — but this point does not need to be reached, because the threshold disposes of the matter before any exoneration clause is considered, and the absence of an advisory is a gap in the bundle, not the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) escalates on. On the remaining routes: there is no amended endpoint (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null), no pooled itinerary (vehicle_type RYDE_X), and no chat instruction (EV-CHAT-02841 holds zero messages), so the booked 12.0 km optimal is the only baseline and it is the correct one; and there is no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) — erp_lines is empty, no airport surcharge appears, and the 14.4 km charged distance is the same measurement as the 14.39 km trace, not a phantom line. No driver compensation arises because the rider was not billed for less distance than the trace records (14.4 km billed against 14.39 km traced). No referral is produced: POL-RD-06(c) is not engaged because no MATERIAL deviation was established and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 196, so no repeat pattern exists, and POL-RD-09(4) has no billing defect to refer. The deciding fact rests on the GPS trace and trip_record, each at full weight 1.0, so confidence is not discounted. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

The establishment test therefore fails and no deviation exists, 'however the rider characterises the trip'.
